summary: Proof-worth entries for the bounded fixed video-only recording producer.

entries.contract: One exact fixed display, window, or single-display global region is topology-bound before an H.264 QuickTime video-only producer acquires native or file authority. Closed duration, frame-rate, pixel, queue, and byte caps, deterministic stop/drain, exact registered-set revision, producer-backed reveal/remove/release, specifically unavailable retain, boot cleanup, and zero-residual terminal publication converge across source, schema, and help.
entries.worth: This catches audio or follow-geometry widening, authority before persistence, parallel ScreenCaptureKit ownership, stale geometry acceptance, unbounded encoding, false custody, early terminal publication, incomplete cleanup, help/schema drift, and native type errors without acquiring Screen Recording permission or recording pixels.
entries.guard: schema, static source, deterministic fake state/encoder/custody model, and whole-source Swift compile only; no daemon, raw repo build, ScreenCaptureKit execution, AVAssetWriter execution, native UI, TCC, or media retention
